cohort: The study included 100 obese parturients (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2) undergoing cesarean section delivery under combined spinal-epidural anesthesia.
finding: Prophylactic phenylephrine effectively prevented spinal anesthesia-induced hypotension (SAIH) in obese parturients undergoing cesarean delivery, with ED50 and ED90 values determined to be 0.42 and 0.68 mg/kg/min, respectively.
followup_time: Until the delivery of the newborn
